design_gotchas.title: NOT Ceramic-Cap Stable — Requires 22 uF Solid Tantalum (No Numeric ESR Window Published)
design_gotchas.detail: Page 4 Stability explicitly mandates a minimum 22 uF solid tantalum capacitor to place the ESR zero in the loop-stable region and omits numeric ESR bounds. Using low-ESR MLCC ceramic capacitors directly on VOUT frequently causes hundreds-of-kHz oscillation; use tantalum, electrolytic, or a ceramic-stable candidate alternative such as AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1.

design_gotchas.title: SOT-223 Thermal Tab is VOUT (Not GND) & High 1.1–1.3 V Dropout
design_gotchas.detail: The SOT-223 mounting tab is internally tied to Pin 2 (VOUT), so pouring a GND heatsink under the tab creates a dead short (p.1, p.5). Its quasi-LDO NPN Darlington pass stage also drops 1.1 V typ / 1.3 V max at 0.8 A, demanding VIN >= 4.6 V (4.8 V test spec) and limiting usable VIN headroom to 15 V abs max.

design_gotchas.title: High 5 mA Quiescent Current & 1.2 W SOT-223 Thermal Ceiling
design_gotchas.detail: AMS1117-3.3 draws 5 mA typ (11 mA max) quiescent current even at no load (p.3), making it unsuitable for battery-powered sleep rails. Regulation is guaranteed only up to 1.2 W in SOT-223 (Note 2, p.3), so 12 V-to-3.3 V operation limits continuous load current to under ~135 mA.

design_gotchas.title: Widespread Counterfeit / Clone Ecosystem & Strict 15 V Abs Max
design_gotchas.detail: Because generic '1117' clones vary wildly in stability, dropout, and voltage rating, always verify authentic Advanced Monolithic Systems DS1117 specs—especially the lower 15 V absolute maximum VIN compared to LM1117/NCP1117 (20 V) and AZ1117C (18 V).

typical_use_cases: 5 V USB or wall-adapter to 3.3 V power rails on development boards and consumer electronics
Cost-sensitive linear post-regulation where 5 mA IQ and 22 uF tantalum COUT are acceptable
Legacy 1117 SOT-223 footprint baseline for evaluating ceramic-stable or lower-IQ candidate drop-ins
High-efficiency moderate-current (<= 500 mA) 5 V-to-3.3 V rails with generous VOUT copper heatsinking
engineering_summary: The Advanced Monolithic Systems AMS1117-3.3 is the ubiquitous 1 A (0.8 A dropout-rated), 15 V max-VIN SOT-223-3 linear regulator with classic 1117 pinout (1=GND, 2/Tab=VOUT, 3=VIN). It requires a 22 uF solid tantalum output capacitor for stability (not MLCC-stable), exhibits 1.1 V typ / 1.3 V max dropout and 5 mA typ quiescent current, and has a 15 V abs-max input ceiling. Engineers evaluating LM1117, AZ1117C, NCP1117, or TLV1117 as candidate drop-ins must verify ESR stability, VIN rating, and thermal copper area before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.1 confirmed SOT-223 Top View pinout (1=Ground/Adjust, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) and thermal tab tied to VOUT.
300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.2-3 confirmed VIN abs max=15 V, TJ=-40 to 125°C, θJA=90°C/W, θJC=15°C/W, PD=1.2 W (Note 2), VDROP=1.1 V typ / 1.3 V max @0.8 A, IQ=5 mA typ / 11 mA max, PSRR=72 dB typ.
Verified 22 uF solid tantalum stability requirement on p.4; esr_min_ohm and esr_max_ohm honestly left null because DS1117 publishes no numeric ESR limits.
